title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is a measure of a model's ability to identify all relevant instances. It is calculated as the number of true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false negatives. Think about which model has the highest ability to capture all relevant instances.

title: Analyzing Model Performance
text: Consider the confusion matrix for each model. Recall focuses on the true positive rate. Which model has the highest true positive rate compared to its false negatives?
